title: When and Why Do Linear Bias Probes Fail? A Geometric and Statistical Theory of Bias Detectability in Large Language Model Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.22337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear probing is the standard instrument for detecting social biases in the hidden representations of large language models. Yet reported probe accuracies come almost exclusively from \emph{counterfactual} evaluations in which every input carries an explicit demographic marker. Once only a fraction $\alpha$ of inputs carries demographic information, performance degrades sharply, and a weak probe may reflect either an unbiased model or an underpowered detector. We develop a theory that resolves this ambiguity. Modeling representations as two class-conditional clusters with Mahalanobis separation $s$ on a manifold of curvature $\kap$, we prove: (i) a finite-sample generalization bound governed by the manifold's extrinsic radius with a matching $\smash{\sqrt{\dB/n}}$ minimax lower bound; (ii) an exact purity law for the maximum linear-probe AUC, strictly increasing in $\alpha$; (iii) a curvature ceiling: ambient chordal separation on a s

translated_title: 何时以及为何线性偏差探针会失效？大语言模型表示中偏差可检测性的几何与统计理论
translated_abstract: 线性探针是检测大语言模型隐藏表示中社会偏见的标准工具。然而，已报告的探针准确率几乎完全来自“反事实”评估，即每个输入都带有显式的人口统计标记。一旦只有比例为 α 的部分输入携带人口统计信息，性能就会急剧下降，此时一个较弱的探针既可能意味着模型本身无偏见，也可能意味着检测器能力不足。我们发展了一套理论来消除这一歧义。将表示建模为曲率为 κ 的流形上具有马氏距离分离度 s 的两个类条件聚类，我们证明：(i) 由流形外蕴半径支配的有限样本泛化上界，并配有相匹配的 √(d_B/n) 极小极大下界；(ii) 最大线性探针 AUC 的精确纯度定律，该定律随 α 严格递增；(iii) 曲率上限：流形上的环境弦分离……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了首个关于线性偏差探针可检测性的几何与统计理论，证明了泛化界、AUC纯度定律和曲率上限，从而能够区分“模型无偏见”与“探针检测能力不足”这两种情形，并解释了当输入中人口统计标记比例降低时探针性能为何急剧退化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a geometric and statistical theory of bias detectability for linear probes, proving generalization bounds, an exact AUC purity law, and a curvature ceiling that disambiguate unbiased models from underpowered detectors and explain why probe performance collapses as the fraction of demographically-marked inputs decreases.
